{"code":"# Inputs extracted from the invoice (currency unspecified)
frame_total = 149.00  # Total (tax incl.) for frame
lens_total_each = 476.40  # Total (tax incl.) per lens after discount
num_lenses = 2

# Sanity check: sum of items equals invoice total
sum_items = frame_total + lens_total_each * num_lenses
print('Check sum items = invoice total?', round(sum_items,2) == round(invoice_total,2), sum_items)

# Insurance coverage
lens_total = lens_total_each * num_lenses
